archetypes.name: dyn-hook-isolation
archetypes.rationale: Cross-clone marker filtering affects every bg-wait deny path and should be checked for leakage or over-filtering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the hook changes that filter live .bg-wait-active markers by .larch-keepalive CLONE_PATH before deny loops run. Focus on whether foreign markers are excluded from Bash, Read, Monitor, TaskOutput, waiter, and probe-clamp paths without weakening same-clone protection. Check fail-safe behavior when cwd or keepalive identity is missing or malformed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
